paraphrase: Once it is established (by co-apprehension and similar proofs) that all appearances are one's own mind, like a dream, the inference of another mind-stream from speech and action fails at the ultimate level; other streams are admitted only conventionally.

differs_from.note: Dharmakīrti proves other minds; Ratnakīrti denies they are ultimately established
